Commentary.Commentary: So 255 is the target for the hosts to inflict a whitewash on Australia. The Proteas will be happy with their effort and will back themselves to get over the line. Australia, on the other hand, head into the break with momentum and will look to end the tour with a win and save some blushes. Who will come out on top? Join us after the break to find out.

Marnus Labuschagne is caught down for a quick chat with Mark Nicholas. Labuschagne tells that he is a bit shaken right now. Feels that he was bit slow at the start but they spoke during the Drinks break and then he decided to carry on for as long as possible. On his maiden century celebration, Marnus says that he was not sure what he wanted to do after making to his crease with a dive to get to the milestone. Tells that his family is there in the crowd and he is really happy. On being a South African representing Australia, Marnus replies that he left the country really young and he is fully Australian now but he has a soft corner for South Africa too. Feels that the wicket is not easy to bat on and hopes that Zampa can take a few wickets with the ball as it is stopping on the surface a bit.

South Africa will be a bit annoyed but overall they will be happy. Why so? You ask, because they started off brilliantly and had put the Aussies on the mat. They kept picking up wickets at regular intervals and it looked like they would restrict the visitors under 230 but 53 runs from the last 5 overs meant that they ended up conceding more than 250. Nortje and Smuts were excellent with the ball and ended up with 2 wickets each. Daryn Dupavillon and Andile Phehlukwayo got one apiece. Maharaj did not get a wicket but was tidy. Overall they would have been happy to chase anything under 260 and that is what they will have to.

After being put into bat, Australia got off to a disastrous start losing the big three comprising of Warner, Smith and Finch early. Labuschagne and Short then gave the much-needed stability to the innings. Short though could not capitalize on the start, Labuschagne went from strength to strength and his superb 108 along with cameos from Marsh and Jhye took Australia to a supremely competitive total of 254 on a slowish pitch.

The new Australian messiah who has dominated Tests since the mid of 2019 has arrived in white ball cricket and announced himself in style. Take a bow Marnus Labuschagne! His excellent ton has helped Australia post a very good total on a pitch that is not easy to bat on.

A bye to end the innings. Full and outside off, Kane swings hard but misses. Both the batters though show great presence of mind and cross over for a quick bye as de Kock's attempt to run the batsman down at his end does not work. Australia end with 254/7.
Kane Richardson is the next batsman in.

OUT! Timber! Labuschagne falls but what a knock from him. The crowd applauds the effort as he walks off. A back of a hand ball from Nortje, Labuschagne moves across to the off side and looks to hammer it over fine leg but he swings it a little too early and misses. The ball crashes on the middle stump. An excellent knock comes to the end but not before he has taken his side towards a very good total.
Full and on middle, Richardson drives it firmly back to the bowler who does well to stop the ball with his right foot and deflect it towards long on. A single taken.
Swing and a miss! That bat is in the air too. Richardson swung it little too hard there as he missed getting bat to this length ball just outside off. He swings hard but fails to connect.
EDGY FOUR! But Richardson won't care. Nortje bowls this length ball outside off, Richardson looks to reach out but the ball takes the bottom edge and races away to the third man fence.
Length ball angled into the batter from Nortje. Labuschagne flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Single to end but Labuschagne will take the strike in the next over. Full and around off, Labuschagne flicks it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a run.
Quick single! A length ball around off, Labuschagne strokes it towards covers. Richardson wanted a run but he has been sent back.

In the air... but just short. A slower bouncer from Phehlukwayo. Labuschagne fails to time his pull well. It goes high in the air towards deep mid-wicket. Klaasen from deep mid-wicket comes charging in to catch but the ball drops well short of him. Two more for Labuschagne.
Another fuller one on middle, Labuschagne works it towards deep mid-wicket and scampers back for a quick couple.
Full and on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Phehlukwayo tries to stay away from the hitting zone but ends up bowling it way outside off. Richardson lets it go. Wided by the umpire.
Length ball just outside off, Labuschagne slams it back to the bowler who fails to collect the ball and allows the batters to get a single.
Shortish and around off and middle, it is worked towards the leg side for a single. Another 50-run stand is raised and the duo will now look to power the Aussies in these last 2 overs.

HUNDRED FOR MARNUS LABUSCHAGNE! You must have heard a lot about him but this is his maiden one in ODIs. He has played a superb knock and he has once again shown his grit and talent in a pitch which is not the easiest to bat on. Fairytale way to get his first ODI ton. He gets it in  the country of his birth.  He pumps both his fist and removes his helmet as everyone in the crowd gets on their feet and applaud the genius that is Marnus Labuschagne. Fuller ball on off and middle, Labuschagne shuffles and flicks it to the right of mid-wicket. He calls for two straightaway. The fielder gets to the ball quickly and sends a throw at the keeper's end. Labuschagne puts in a dive to get to his crease and gets in safely. A moment he will never forget. A brace that will be carved in his memory forever.
Three now! Excellent stuff from Richardson now. Nortje goes full and on middle, Richardson powerfully smashes it towards wide long on. The fielder from long on does well to save a run for his side.

TOP EDGE AND FOUR! Once again the batsman will not care. Nortje bangs it short and on middle, Richardson goes for the pull but gets a top edge. The ball flies over the keeper and into the fence at fine leg.
Short and on middle, Marnus pulls it to deep square leg and moves to 98.
Risky run! Full and outside off, Richardson drives it towards covers uppishly and takes a run.
Anrich Nortje is back on. 5-0-17-1 are his figures so far.
FOUR! Another one! Three in a row! This is excellent batting from Marnus. Phehlukwayo bowls it short and wide outside off, Labuschagne slaps it over point for a boundary. 15 from the over.

FOUR! Not from the middle of the bat but Labuschagne won't care. He is into the 90's now. Full toss on middle, Labuschagne goes for the slam over mid-wicket but the ball hits the top part of the bat but it goes between the gap at deep mid-wicket and deep square leg. Two fielders try to get around and field but fails to do so.
FOUR! That is slammed with power. Phehlukwayo bowls it full and outside off, Labuschagne creams it through extra cover for a boundary.
Good length ball around off, Richardson guides it towards third man for a single.

Dropped! That was hit really hard but Klaasen did get both the hands to it. Short and outside off, Richardson goes for the pull. He times it well but it goes towards Klaasen at short mid-wicket. The ball goes quickly to him as he tries to take the catch but the ball bursts through him and a couple taken.
Shortish and around off, Richardson drives it on the up but finds point.
Andile Phehlukwayo is back on. 5-0-26-1 are his figures so far.
Good finish to the over by Sipamla. He bowls it on a fuller length and around off, Labuschagne comes forward and defends it out.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Labuschagne looks to punch but gets an inside edge to the keeper.
A couple now! 11 from the over already. Sipamla bowls a full ball on the pads, Labuschagne works it wide of the man at deep square leg. Before the fielder can get to the ball, a couple taken.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! South Africa have been very good in the field but on this occassion the debutant Daryn Dupavillon has let his side down. Length delivery outside off, Labuschagne once again stays on his back foot. He goes to the off side this time and cuts it through backward point. Dupavillon runs to his right from third man and puts in a dive. He gets to the ball but fails to hold onto it. The ball goes past him and to the fence.

FOUR! Intense battle going on between Sipamla and Labuschagne and at the moment it is Marnus who is winning it. Good length delivery on off, Labuschagne gets on his back foot and pulls it in front of square for a boundary.
WIDE! Sipamla bowls a bouncer, Marnus lets it sail through to the keeper.
On a good length on middle, Labuschagne looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad.
A dot to end! Tossed up ball on middle, Richardson blocks it onto the pitch.
On middle, worked towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and just outside off, Labuschagne squeezes it wide of the sweeper cover fielder for a couple of runs. 200 up for the Aussies.
Short and around off, punched to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Thumped! This should break the shackles for the Aussies. Smuts drops it just short and outside off, Richardson goes on the back foot and slams it through the covers for a boundary.
Tossed up delivery on off, Richardson keeps it out.

Quick run to end the over. A fuller ball around off, Richardson pushes it towards mid off and takes a quick run as the fielder from that position misses his shy at the non-striker's end. 4 from the over, another excellent one for South Africa.
Good length ball around off, Richardson defends it towards mid on.
Shortish and on middle, it is worked towards deep square leg for a run.
On a length on middle, Richardson flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
On a good length on off, Jhye defends it off the back foot.
Short delivery on middle, Labuschagne pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and around off again, Richardson stays on the back foot and keeps it out. Double wicket maiden. One of the wicket belongs to Miller as run out and the other to Smuts.
Floated on off, blocked.
Jhye Richardson is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! JJ Smuts knocks Carey over! This is a ripper from him and Carey departs for a duck. Smuts bowls this flatter one around off and slower through the air. Carey is early in his push towards the off side off his back foot. The ball turns just enough to beat his bat and disturb the top of off.
Tossed up delivery on off, Carey plays it to covers.
Slower through the air and on the pads, Carey works it towards short fine leg.
Alex Carey is the next batsman in.

OUT! RUN OUT! David Miller is the man once again. What an excellent piece of fielding from him. Full and outside off, Labuschagne drives it towards covers firmly. Miller though at that position throws himself to his right and flicks the ball quickly to the keeper. The batters have already taken off so de Kock collects the ball and whips the bails off to find Marsh short. No need to go for the third umpire there as Marsh is nowhere in the picture. Another threatening-looking stand has been broken.
Yes, he can. It is a dot ball. A length ball around off, Marsh pushes it towards point. Just 4 from the over.
Good length ball around off, Labuschagne runs it down to third man for a single. 4 from the over. Can Sipamla finish the over well?
Bouncer now! Marsh mistimes his pull towards deep mid-wicket. He gets only a run.
On the pads, Labuschagne clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

Direct hit and it would've been close. Full and just outside off, Marsh strokes it towards mid off and takes off for a single. Verreynne there gets to the ball quickly and fires the throw at the non-striker's end but misses. Marsh would've been a goner had he hit. 50-run stand is up between Marsh and Labuschagne.
Short and wide outside off, Marsh throws his bat but fails to connect.
Lutho Sipamla is back on. 5-0-21-0 are his figures so far.
Excellent stop from Miller. Smuts tosses it outside off, Labuschagne drives it firmly but Miller dives to his right and makes an excellent save.
Fires it on the pads, Marsh works it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 5 singles in the over.
Short and just outside off, once again it is slapped towards sweeper cover for a run.
Tossed up on off, pushed through mid off for a single.
Short and wide outside off again, Labuschagne slaps it through covers and takes a single.
Short and down the leg side, Marsh flicks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Powerplay 3 time! Maximum of 5 fielders can be outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
Another ball angled into the pads, Marsh once again misses to connect his flick. The ball takes the inside edge and hits pads and drops towards the leg side. They take a quick leg bye.
WIDE! Goes for the length ball but sprays it down the leg side. Marsh looks to flick but misses. Wided by the umpire.
Another full ball on the pads, Marsh flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Full and on the pads again, Marsh looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball goes towards deep square leg and they take two leg byes.
Full and on the pads, Marsh looks to flick but misses.
Fuller and on the pads, Labuschagne flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Good length ball around off, pushed towards covers.
Play and a miss! A flighted ball outside off, Marsh throws his arms at it but is early into the shot. It beats the outside edge and goes to the keeper.
Floated around off, Marsh comes forward and defends it towards the off side.
FOUR! Poor bowling and Marsh latches onto it. Short and wide from Smuts, Marsh quickly rocks back and slashes it through point for another boundary.
Slower through the air and around off, this one is pushed back to the bowler.
Loopy delivery on off, Marsh plays it to covers.
FOUR! Tossed up delivery on off, Marsh looks to guide but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man for a boundary.
JJ Smuts is back on. 5-0-21-1 are his figures so far.
Good length delivery on middle, Labuschagne defends it off the back foot.
On a length on off, Marsh dabs it towards third man for a single.
SIX! Amazing shot! Short delivery on middle, Marsh pulls it over square leg for a maximum. You don't bowl short to Mitchell. Also, a welcome boundary for the Aussies.
On a good length on off, Marsh keeps it out.
Full delivery on off, Marsh drives it towards mid off.
On a length on middle, Labuschagne flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Daryn Dupavillon is back on. 4-0-10-1 are his figures so far.
Shortish and around off, Marsh clips it towards mid-wicket and takes a single. Maharaj finishes his spell with figures of 10-0-45-0.
On the pads, Marsh works it to deep square leg and takes a single.
Quicker one around off, Marsh looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge. It goes towards short third man.
Tossed up on middle, Marsh defends it back to the bowler.
Full and just outside off, Labuschagne strokes it to long off and takes a single.
Shorter and slower through the air, Marsh strokes it to sweeper cover and gets a run.
Fuller and around off, pushed to long on for a single.
On the pads, it is worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Another shortish ball around off, Labuschagne blocks it off his back foot.
Flatter and around off, blocked.

Excellent save in the deep from Maharaj! A fuller one outside off from Smuts, Labuschagne drills it through the covers. The ball is racing towards the fence but Maharaj from sweeper cover runs to his right and dives to make an excellent save. Two saved.
Fuller and around off and middle, this is flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, Labuschagne strokes it down to long off for a single.
Shortish and around off, Marsh punches it towards covers and takes a run. 150 up for the Proteas.
Full and just outside off, Marsh strokes it towards covers where the fielder dives to his right and pushes it towards the bowler.
Full and on off, Marsh drives it straight to covers.
BEATEN! Loopy delivery just outside off, Marsh looks to sweep but misses it.
Flighted delivery on off, Labuschagne drives it through mid off for a run.
On off, Labuschagne punches it towards long on for a run.
Full delivery on off, Marsh drives it through covers for a single.
On middle, Marsh defends it off the front foot.
Loopy delivery on middle, Labuschagne flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Marnus punches it to point.
Tossed up delivery on off, Labuschagne drives it through covers. The batsmen get two runs.

Drinks Break! After losing the top three early, Labuschagne and Short did really well to pull the Aussies back in the game but Short's dismissal before this break means that South Africa have the better control on the game. They will look to take a few more quickly to push the Aussies further back in the game. Labuschagne, on the other hand, will love another partner who can hang around with him in the middle and add another good stand. Let's see if Marsh can give him that support.
Gives this air on off, MM defends it to negotiate the over.
Floated on the stumps, Marsh keeps it out.

Good bowling! Turn and bounce on this one. It is pitched on off and it turns away sharply. Marsh looks to punch it off his back foot with a straight bat but the ball just about misses the outside edge and the off pole.
Around the pads, Marnus flicks it to the leg side and gets to the other end.
Shorter on off, Labuschagne punches it but finds backward point inside the circle.
Flatter on off, Marsh punches it to deep point and gets to the other end.
Short and wide again, Marsh punches it through covers and takes a run.
Short and wide outside off, Marsh cuts it through backward point and takes two more.
Full and around off again, Marsh finds short extra cover again.
Full and around off, pushed towards short extra cover.
Short and wide outside off, Marsh cuts it to sweeper cover for a couple to get off the mark.
The new man in is Mitchell Marsh.

OUT! Caught! The partnership that was recovering the innings for the Aussies and laying the platform has come to an end and it is a big blow for the tourists. Smuts with the breakthrough. Smart bowling from JJ. He bowls it slower and on middle and leg, Short looks to flick but does so uppishly as the ball arrives a lot slower than he anticipated. He ends up hitting it to the left of short mid-wicket. Klaasen, who has had a tremendous series is once again in the thick of action. He moves to his left and takes a good catch tumbling down.
Shortish and around off again, Labuschagne slaps it wide of the man at sweeper cover and scampers back for a couple of runs.
On the pads, Short flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

50 up for Marnus Labuschagne. His 2nd in ODI. Excellent knock so far from him and now he will look to convert this into his maiden ODI ton. Maharaj drops it short and outside off, Marnus slaps it down to sweeper cover for a singe.
Tossed up outside off, Short strokes it to long off for a single.
Quicker one around middle and leg, Labuschagne works it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full and on the pads, Marnus paddles it to fine leg and takes two to move to 48.
Flatter and around off and middle, punched down to long on for a run.
Short and outside off, Labuschagne cuts but finds point.
Quicker one on middle, Short strokes it towards long on for a single.
Shortish and around off, pushed towards mid on.
Flatter and on middle, pushed towards mid-wicket.
Flatter and on middle, Marnus guides it through cover-point for a single.
On off, Labuschagne plays it towards covers for a single.
Tossed up delivery on off, Marnus guides it towards third man. The batsmen get two runs.

NOT OUT! Poor review from South Africa. There was no pad actually, the ball went off the bat. Flighted delivery on middle and leg, Labuschagne looks to sweep but the ball goes fine down the leg side. The South African players put in a huge appeal but the umpire turns it down. The batters meanwhile take a brace. De Kock has a word with his bowler, the skipper is not too keen to take the review but Maharaj has his way and de Kock signals the 'T'. Replay rolls in and Ultra Edge shows that it came off the bat throughout. South Africa lose their sole review. Can't blame de Kock too much as it was the bowler's review.

LBW appeal has been referred upstairs by the South Africans. De Kock thought that there was bat involved but Maharaj felt otherwise and forced his skipper to go for the DRS. The replays roll in and show that there was an inside edge on that one. Poor, poor review from Maharaj. South Africa lose their review.
FOUR! Swept powerfully. Full and just outside off, Labuschagne gets in position and powerfully sweeps it to deep square leg. The ball races away to the fence in a jiffy.
Tossed up on off, stroked through mid off for a single.
Flatter and around off, pushed towards mid on.
A dot to end as Marnus strokes this full ball back to the bowler. 4 runs off it.
Flatter and just outside off, Labuschagne goes on the back foot and punches it well but he finds the man at cover-point.
Shorter again from Smuts, it is around off and middle, Short strokes it through mid on for a single.
Short and outside off, Labuschagne pulls it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Shortish and turning into the batter, Short works it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Smuts starts with a fuller ball around off, Labuschagne pushes it down to long on for a single.
JJ Smuts is into the attack now.
Floated delivery on middle, Marnus flicks it through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! On middle, Labuschagne sweeps it through square leg for a boundary.
Floated delivery on middle, Marnus defends it off the back foot.
Loopy delivery on off, Short punches it through mid off for a single.
Floated delivery on middle, Labuschagne flicks it through mid-wicket for a single. 50-run stand is up between Labuschagne and Short.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Short flicks it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and around off, it is punched back to the bowler who misfields and allows a single.

A couple now! Klaasen once again bowls a fuller ball around off and middle, Labuschagne comes down the track and smashes it wide of the long off fielder. Before the fielder can come across and collect the ball, the batters scamper back for two.
Full and around off, pushed through mid off for a single.

100 up for Australia. They have rebuilt well and now look to keep going. A quicker one on middle, Marnus looks to flick but the ball takes the outside edge and goes towards short third man for a single.
Full and around off, Labuschagne pushes it back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Short strokes it down to long off for a single.
Flatter and on the pads, this one is worked towards deep mid-wicket by Short for a run. Just 2 from the over, another tight one from Maharaj. Australia are 98/3 after 25 overs.
Three dots in a row as Short pushes this fuller ball around off and middle back to the bowler.
Flatter on middle, worked towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Short drives it well but straight to extra cover.
Drops short and just outside off, Labuschagne strokes it to long off and takes a single.
Loopy ball around off, pushed back to the bowler.

Quicker one on the pads, Labuschagne clips it towards deep square leg. They once again think for a couple but Nortje in the deep is quick to get to the ball and throw the ball to the keeper, so only a run. 5 from Klaasen's second over.
Another single as Short this time drives it down to long off.
On off, Marnus comes down the track and pushes it through mid off for a single.
Slower through the air and around off and middle, Labuschagne works it straight to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, it is stroked down to long off for a single.
Full and around off, Labuschagne comes down the track and pushes it to long on for a run.
Quicker one outside off on a shortish length, Labuschagne punches it through cover-point. The call is for two but they settle for a single.
Flatter and on middle, turning in, Short works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, Short punches it back towards the bowler.
Loopy delivery on middle, Marnus flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated delivery on off, Marnus punches it to point.
Tossed up delivery on off, Labuschagne drives it to covers.
Full and outside off, Labuschagne firmly drives it towards long off for a single. 8 from the over.
Tossed up and just outside off, Short works it through mid off for a run.
Floated on middle, Labuschagne strokes it through mid on for a single.
Flatter and on middle, blocked towards mid-wicket.
Short and around off, D'Arcy pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. He will feel that he missed out a chance there.
FOUR! He has been welcomed into the attack with a boundary! Full and on the pads from him, Short hammers it over square leg and the ball rolls towards the fence.
Well, well, well. Guess who is in to bowl now? It is Heinrich Klaasen. He has had a superb series so far with the bat. Let us see what he brings to the table with the ball.
Loopy delivery around off and middle, Short pushes it through mid off for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Short sweeps but finds short fine leg this time.
Quicker one around off, Short works it towards mid-wicket.
Floated around off, Labuschagne strokes it through mid off for a single.
Flatter and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Short flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Bouncer on middle, Labuschagne goes for the pull but misses to get hit on the body.
Good length ball around off, Short pushes it towards mid on and takes a quick run.
Shortish and around off, Short blocks it off his back foot.
Full and outside off, Short looks to drive but the ball takes the inner half of the bat and goes back to the bowler.
FOUR! Flicked nicely! Phehlukwayo strays on the pads of Short who whips it powerfully through mid-wicket and the ball races away to the fence.
Full and around off, Labuschagne flicks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a run.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Short keeps it out.
On off, Labuschagne plays it towards covers for a single.
Floated delivery on middle, D'Arcy drives it through mid on for a run.
Loopy delivery on off, Marnus drives it through mid off for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Labuschagne blocks it off the back foot.
Tossed up delivery on off, Labuschagne drives it to covers.
Keshav Maharaj is on.
FOUR! Terrific shot! Full delivery on off, Short drives it through covers for a boundary.
Good length delivery on off, Short keeps it out.
Full delivery on off, D'Arcy drives it to covers.
On a length on middle, Short flicks it through square leg. The batsmen get two runs.
Length delivery outside off, Labuschagne slaps it through covers for a run.
On a length on middle, Short flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full delivery on off, Marnus drives it towards mid off.
On a good length on off, Labuschagne blocks it well.
On a length on middle, Short flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery on off, D'Arcy keeps it out.
On a good length on off, Short blocks it off the back foot.
BEATEN! Full delivery outside off, Short looks to drive but misses it.
Good length ball around off, Marnus taps it onto the pitch off his back foot.
Length ball on the pads, Labuschagne works it towards mid-wicket.
Full and on middle, Labuschagne flicks it nicely. The man at mid-wicket looks to stop but ends up parrying it towards long on. They get a couple.
Good length ball outside off, Labuschagne lets it be.
Full and on the pads, Short flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark on the first ball he faces.
Shortish and outside off, Labuschagne strokes it through covers for a single.
D'Arcy Short is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Yes, he has his fingers under the ball. Dupavillon gets his maiden ODI wicket. It's an excellent grab from Miller. Dupavillon spears in and bowls a fuller ball outside off, Finch looks to drive but does so uppishly towards Miller at extra cover. It goes towards Miller who pouches the ball inches above the turf. The umpires though want to confirm if the catch is clean and they refer it upstairs. Replays come in and show that Miller has his fingers underneath the ball. So, Finch has to walk back and Australia now, in a real spot of bother. Tight lines and lengths from the Proteas are fetching them the rewards. Big wicket for the Proteas and one that Dupavillon will remember for the rest of his life. The top 3 is back in the pavilion for the tourists and they are in real trouble here.
Finch has been caught. The umpires though want to be sure that Miller has taken a clean catch. Let's see the replays. Looks like Finch has to depart because Miller has his fingers under the ball.
Good length ball around off, Finch comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Shortish and around off, Labuschagne punches it through covers for an easy single.
Fuller and around off, Finch this time drives it to sweeper cover and takes a run.

South Africa have been excellent in the field and this time it is Klaasen who makes a brilliant stop. Short and outside off, Finch cuts it powerfully but Miller dives to his right and saves 4 for his side brilliantly. Excellent fielding from the Proteas so far.
Shortish and just around off, Finch taps it towards covers.
Full delivery outside off, Finch drives it through covers for a single.
Length delivery on off, Aaron plays it to point.
On a good length on middle, Finch looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad.
WIDE! Phehlukwayo bowls it down the leg side, Finch lets it go.
Outside off, Finch offers no shot to this one.
On a good length on middle, Labuschagne flicks it towards square leg for a run.
FOUR! That is a fine stroke! On a length on middle, Labuschagne flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary. 50 up for Australia.
Shorter in length and around off, Finch defends it out off his back foot.

Excellent work at extra cover from Miller! Fuller and just around off, Finch strokes it firmly towards extra cover but Miller dives to his left and makes an excellent stop. The ball though does not stick in his hands and deflects away towards covers and Finch calls for the single but Labuschagne sends him back. Finch is not happy with that.
Good length ball on off, Finch pushes it towards point.
Shortish and around off, Finch keeps it out off his back foot.
Labuschagne is off the mark. A shortish ball around off, Labuschagne taps it through covers and takes a run.
Short and outside off, Finch cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Shortish and around off, Labuschagne works it towards mid-wicket. End of a successful over from Phehlukwayo. Just a run and the massive wicket of Smith from it.
On a good length and outside off, Marnus shoulders arms to this one.
WIDE! Length delivery down the leg side, Labuschagne looks to flick but misses it.
Full and around off, Labuschagne drives it towards mid off.
Marnus Labuschagne is the next batsman in.

OUT! LBW! Umpire's call on hitting the wickets. Phehlukwayo gets the big fish. The shuffle across the off stump has cost Smith his wicket. Phehlukwayo bowls this length ball around middle and leg, Smith does his usual shuffle and looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. The bowler makes a loud appeal and the umpire agrees. Smith and Finch get together, they discuss the DRS option and eventually go for it. Let's see the replays. First up, it is front foot. It is fine. No bat either, confirms Ultra Edge. It is pitching in line as well and just clipping the leg pole. The on-field umpire's decision stays but Smith has to depart.

Steven Smith has been given out LBW! He has a word with his skipper who suggests him to go for the DRS. Looks close. The front foot is fine and there is no bat which is confirmed by the Ultra Edge. Pitching in line and umpire's call on hitting the wickets. Australia keep their review but lose Smith.
Gets closer to the off pole on a length but Smith has his stumps covered as he shoulders arms.
Phehlukwayo starts with a length ball outside off, Smith lets it go to the keeper as he thinks that it is outside the tramline but the umpire feels it is fine.
Andile Phehlukwayo is on.
Short and around off, Finch looks to pull but gets an inside edge on the body. Tight first over after getting hit for a boundary on the second ball of the over by Dupavillon.

Beaten! Excellent delivery from the debutant. Bowls it slightly fuller and outside off. He invites Finch for the drive who obliges and goes for it away from his body. The ball though moves away a hint to beat the outside edge.
Slightly short and just around off, it is slapped to sweeper cover for a single.
Good length ball around off, Smith keeps it out.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Short and outside off, Smith cuts it through point for a boundary.
Uppish but safe! A length ball around off from Dupavillon to begin his ODI career. Smith looks to defend but the ball hits the upper part of the bat and lobs towards covers uppishly.
Powerplay 2 is signalled. Maximum of 4 fielders can be outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Daryn Dupavillon is into the attack. It is his ODI debut.
A leave to end the over as Finch shoulders arms to this length ball outside off. 10 from it. 38/1 at the end of Powerplay 1.
On a good length on off, Finch keeps it out.
Full delivery on middle, Finch flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen pick up a couple.
FOUR! Pulled away! Excellent stuff from Finch. He is now getting into the groove. Sipamla bowls a short ball around off, Finch rocks back and hammers it to the deep mid-wicket fence via a pull shot.
Shortish and around off, Finch stays on the back foot and defends it out.

FOUR! Good effort from Smuts but he fails to stop the boundary. A length ball on middle and leg, Finch flicks it towards deep mid-wicket and the ball races away. The outfield is very fast but Smuts from deep square leg runs across and dives to save the run. The third umpire has been called in to confirm if it is a clean stop but replays roll in and show that he had touched the ball when his body was in contact with the ropes.

Good shot but very good fielding. Kyle Verreynne saves a certain boundary at point. Good length delivery on off, Finch punches it to the left of Verreynne. He dives but fails to hang onto it, allowing them to take a run. Great effort nonetheless.
Another sharp delivery from Nortje. It is bowled at 146 kph and it nips back in. Finch is caught by surprise and ends up getting an inside edge onto the pads.
Good length delivery outside off, Smith runs it down to third man and gets to the other end.
Nortje hits the deck hard around off, Smith defends it to the leg side of the pitch.
Wide outside off on a length, Smith makes a leave.
Play and a miss! A length ball outside off, Smith goes for the drive but the ball nips back in sharply to beat the inside edge.
Around off on a good length, Finch pushes it towards covers to go through the over.
Another length ball just outside off, Finch covers his stumps and lets it be.
Good length ball around off, Smith works it towards deep square leg and takes a single.
Landed around off on a length, Smith tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Full and around off, pushed to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Cracking stroke! Sipamla overpitches this and bowls it just around off, Smith just hammers with straight bat past the bowler and into the fence.

Excellent stop from Maharaj! Saves a run for his side. A fuller ball around off, Smith flicks it through mid-wicket. Maharaj from mid on gives it a chase. It looks like the ball will win the race but Maharaj makes a sliding stop to save a run for his side.

That took off too! Excellent bowling. That was quick as well. It is a length ball just around off, Smith looks to defend it on the up but the ball hits the upper part of the willow and drops towards the off side.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Smith cuts but finds cover-point.

FOUR! This one is an easy picking for Smith. He doesn't miss chances like these. Nortje bowls this length ball angled into the batter. Smith flicks it superbly through mid-wicket and bags his first boundary.
Fuller and around off, Smith once again mistimes his drive, this time it goes towards mid on off the inner half of the bat.

Uppish but falls well short. Fuller and around off, Smith goes for the drive but the bat turns in his hands and the ball goes towards mid off uppishly. There is shout for catch it but it is well short.
Loose shots! The dots are building pressure and Finch tries to release that as he goes after this length ball outside off. He though fails to make the connection.
Around off on a length, Finch pushes it towards mid off.
Full and on middle, Finch strokes it straight to mid on.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid off.
Shortish and on middle, Smith tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and just outside off, Smith shuffles towards the off side and defends it back to the bowler.
Wide outside off on a length, Finch lets it be. End of a successful over for South Africa.
Smith is off the mark! A length ball around middle, Smith clips it towards mid-wicket and takes a run.
Another length ball outside off, Smith shoulders arms once again.
Shortish and just outside off, Smith lets it be.
Steven Smith walks out at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Nortje draws first blood. Absolute jaffa from him. Gets this fuller length ball to shoot off a bit and move away from around off. Warner pokes at it with hard hands but gets an outside edge behind. De Kock pouches it with ease and celebrates. The opening bowlers have bowled superbly and now they have a wicket to show for their brilliant effort. Excellent start for South Africa. Warner's struggling series comes to an end, not the way he would have wanted to return to South Africa.
Shortish and outside off, Finch cuts it towards third man uppishly for a single.
Good length ball around off and middle, Finch pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Good length ball just outside off, Finch shoulders arms.
Length ball around middle and leg, Finch clips it behind square leg and scampers back for a couple of runs.

Quick single! Slightly fuller and around off and middle, Warner comes forward and tucks it towards mid on. He calls for the run straightaway and completes it easily. The mid on fielder gets to the ball quickly and fires the throw at the non-striker's end but misses.
Another length ball around off, Warner taps it towards point and shouts a loud no for the run.
Good length ball on middle, Warner pushes it back to the bowler.
Good length ball around off, Finch pushes it towards point.
FOUR! And he is off the mark in style! Nortje drops it short and around off, Finch swivels and hammers it to deep square leg and the ball races away to the fence.
11 balls now! Full and just outside off, Finch strokes it well but can't beat the extra cover fielder.
Bowls a very full ball on the pads, Warner flicks it to fine leg and gets off strike.
Shortish and around off, Warner hops and pushes it towards covers. Finch wants a single but Warner sends him back.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, Warner looks to poke at it but misses it.
Good length delivery on off, Finch keeps it out. 10 dots and Finch is yet to get off the mark.
On a length on off, Finch taps it towards point.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, Finch looks to defend but misses it due to the seam movement on this one.
On a good length on middle, Finch looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad. The bowler appeals for lbw but the umpire shakes his head.
Length delivery on middle, Finch flicks it towards mid-wicket.
On a length on middle, Warner flicks it through square leg for a single.
Lutho Sipamla to bowl from the other end.
5 dots in a row and this is an excellent first over from Nortje. He bowls the last ball on a length, Finch pushes it back to the bowler. Just 1 from the over.
Fuller and around off, Finch pushes it towards mid off.
Landed around off on a length, Finch pushes it towards covers.
This time Nortje angles a length ball into the pads of Finch. He looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Good length ball around off, Finch comes forward and keeps it out.

Warner is off the mark on the first ball. A shortish ball around off, Warner hops and looks to defend but the ball takes the inside edge and goes past the stumps. It drops near the stumps on the leg side and both the batters cross for a run.

The South African players make their way to the middle. The two Australian openers, David Warner and Aaron Finch make their way to the middle as well. Anrich Nortje with the ball first up. Here we go...

Australia Playing XI - David Warner, Aaron Finch (C), Steven Smith, Marnus Labuschagne, D'Arcy Short, Mitchell Marsh, Alex Carey (WK), Jhye Richardson (In for Mitchell Starc), Kane Richardson (In for Pat Cummins), Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood (In for Ashton Agar).

Australia skipper, Aaron Finch says that there are three changes in his side. On Starc's exclusion, Finch says that he has been traveling with the side for a long time and deserved some off time and support his wife in the T20 World Cup final. Adds that he wanted to bowl first too but he isn't too disappointed. Tells that if they can see off the new ball, they have the chance of posting big total. Feels that they are going little too hard in the middle overs and they probably need to keep wickets in hand for the end. Finishes by saying that they want to go into the New Zealand series with confidence.

South Africa Playing XI - Quinton de Kock (C/WK), Janneman Malan, JJ Smuts, Kyle Verreynne, Heinrich Klaasen, David Miller, Andile Phehlukwayo, Keshav Maharaj, Anrich Nortje, Daryn Dupavillon (ODI DEBUT) (In for Lungi Ngidi), Lutho Sipamla (In for Tabraiz Shamsi).

South Africa skipper, Quinton de Kock says that it is a fresh wicket and there will be something on it in the morning and expects it to get better to bat later on. Informs Ngidi has been given a rest and Shamsi misses out for the birth of his baby. Sipamla and Dupavillon come in place for them with the latter making his debut. Tells they have done well in the series and is happy with their performance.
TOSS - It is time for the spin of the coin. South Africa win the toss and elect to field.

Hello and welcome to the final ODI between South Africa and Australia in Potchefstroom. The hosts would look for a whitewash. Jannemalan Malan played an exceptional innings in the last match. The hosts would expect a big innings from Quinton de Kock. On the other hand, Australia would look to improve their batting. They would want Labuschagne to fire. Stay tuned for the teams and the toss.
